evals.name: create-audit-workflow
evals.prompt: Napisz mi Claude Code dynamic workflow (plik .js do ~/.claude/workflows/) o nazwie audit-routes, który sprawdza każdy handler w src/routes/ pod kątem brakujących sprawdzeń autoryzacji, a każdy finding weryfikuje adwersaryjnie zanim go zaraportuje. Chcę móc podać katalog przez args. Zapisz skrypt do outputs/ i napisz, co trzeba dodać do allow rules przed uruchomieniem.
evals.expected_output: A file audit-routes.js with export const meta first (pure literal, name audit-routes, phases), a discover agent with a schema, a pipeline over files with a refute stage per finding, args guarded, results filtered for null, log() at transitions, labels on fan-out agents, and a short note listing allow rules. The checker returns PASS or WARN with no blockers.
expectations: audit-routes.js exists and the checker finds no blocker (PASS or WARN)
meta is the first statement, a pure literal, named audit-routes
the discover step and the finding handoff use a schema
each finding goes through an adversarial refute stage (prompt says refute/obal, default to refuted)
the target directory comes from args and args is guarded
parallel/pipeline results are filtered for null before use
fan-out agents carry labels and the script logs stage transitions
no nondeterministic call, module import or runtime access
notes name at least one concrete allow rule and the ~/.claude/workflows save location
notes recommend a pilot run on a slice before the full run

evals.name: audit-broken-script
evals.prompt: Sprawdź ten skrypt workflow zanim go odpalę na całym repo i powiedz, co w nim jest nie tak, z priorytetami. Plik: broken-audit-routes.js (dołączony). Nie poprawiaj go, tylko zraportuj.
evals.expected_output: A ranked report that names, at minimum: meta is not the first statement and is not a pure literal, Date.now() breaks resume, parallel() receives promises instead of thunks, the budget.remaining() loop never ends without budget.total, FINDING schema requires a key it does not declare, args is used unguarded, the first agent has no schema although its result is destructured, nulls from parallel() are not filtered, the slice(0, 10) cap is silent. Verdict is fix first or re-shape, not ship. No edits to the file.
expectations: report says meta is not the first statement
report says meta is not a pure literal (DIMENSIONS reference)
report flags Date.now() as breaking resume
report flags parallel() receiving promises instead of thunks
report flags the budget.remaining() loop as unbounded without budget.total
report flags the FINDING schema requiring "summary" that is not declared
report flags args used without a guard
report flags the first agent returning prose because it has no schema
report flags null results from parallel() not being filtered
report flags the slice(0, 10) cap as silent
report gives a verdict that is not ship
the input file was not modified
findings are ranked by severity

evals.name: optimize-slow-review
evals.prompt: Ten workflow działa poprawnie, ale ostatni run zjadł 1.4M tokenów i trwał 26 minut na 3 wymiarach i 31 findingach. Zoptymalizuj go: mniej tokenów i krótszy wall-clock bez utraty weryfikacji. Plik slow-review.js jest dołączony. Zapisz poprawioną wersję do outputs/slow-review.js i wypisz, co zmieniłeś i dlaczego.
evals.expected_output: A rewritten slow-review.js where the two barriers become a pipeline over DIMENSIONS with the verify stage per finding, model overrides removed or justified, effort lowered on the review stage only if justified, labels and log() added, null slots filtered, meta unchanged and still first. The explanation names the levers: pipeline over barrier, prompt-cache prefix sharing, effort per stage. The checker returns PASS.
expectations: optimized slow-review.js exists and the checker returns PASS (no blocker, no major)
the two barriers became a pipeline over DIMENSIONS
per-agent model overrides removed
null slots filtered or guarded
labels on fan-out agents and log() at transitions
meta still first, name slow-review, phases consistent with the body
verification per finding is kept (a refute/verify agent with a verdict schema)
changes.md names pipeline-over-barrier as a lever
changes.md names prompt-cache prefix sharing
changes.md names effort per stage
